pages.text: The Pestilence moves through three stages. It $(l)will not kill you$(), but it will make you weak, slow and miserable, and it costs one $(c)heart$() per stage.$(br2)Milk does nothing for it.

pages.title: The Three Stages
pages.text: $(l)Incubation$() (about 5 minutes): a chill, nothing more. You are not yet contagious.$(br)$(l)Fever$() (about 7 minutes): hunger and coughing. $(4)You now spread it.$()$(br)$(l)Buboes$() (about 10 minutes): weakness, heavy limbs and dizzy spells.$(br2)Then the fever breaks, and you are immune for a time.
